column1: # manual.tsv - build-time dependencies no scanner can see.
#   weight 2 = needed for the same feature set as Pat's package
#   weight 1 = soft (docs, nice to have); used for ordering only
# "!skip <package>" removes a package from the plan.
# Add a line here every time a build fails because something was missing,
# kernel: headers are generated from the installed kernel-source
# wayland-protocols / xkb data are compile-time only
# SDL3 dlopen()s its X11/wayland/audio libraries, so depgraph.db has no
# ELF edges for them.  cmake stops on a missing X11 extension
# ("Couldn't find dependency package for XSCRNSAVER"); the rest are
# switched off quietly, so weight 2 keeps Pat's feature set.
# python modules imported at build time
# man pages written in scdoc: kmod's meson stops without it, seatd's
# man-pages=auto quietly drops them (different package from Pat's)
# shadow --enable-man: configure stops without xsltproc; the man pages are
# built with the DocBook XSL stylesheets (bundled in ap/linuxdoc-tools)
# man pages / docs switched on in the SlackBuild; the tool is never named.
# xsltproc is libxslt, the DocBook stylesheets, gtk-doc and asciidoc are
# libxml2 -Dpython=enabled: the python bindings are generated from the
# linuxdoc-tools.build: "rpm2cpio x.src.rpm | cpio -div" for its sources.
# rpm2cpio is from ap/rpm (a cycle through dbus/elogind): the pass-1
# override uses the kit's tools/rpm2cpio, so rpm is ordering only.
# gtk-doc's meson.build (inside linuxdoc-tools.build) needs the python
# pygments module; without it the build stops half way (slacktrack still
# libical's cmake: ENABLE_GTK_DOC is on by default ("Cannot find all
# elogind: meson dependency('libudev') is required, but no elogind binary
# ends up linking libudev, so depgraph has no edge
# tools/meson-render-jinja2.py (config files, rules) imports jinja2; with
# lxml (xml_helper.py), the same as in systemd
# --with-ldap: configure stops without ldap.h (pass-1 overrides drop it,
# --with-mysql=/usr: links -lmysqlclient, a hard need (ELF edge was soft)
# mariadb: without a system fmt (header only, no ELF edge) cmake downloads
# fmt-*.zip from github; storage/duckdb applies its patch with "git apply"
# (the pass-1 override uses patch, so git is ordering only)
# llvm is built with clang/lld (CMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang, LLVM_USE_LINKER=lld):
# itself.  The pass-1 override uses gcc; "# drop: llvm" rebuilds it in pass 2.
# hwdata's SlackBuild downloads pci.ids/usb.ids with lftpget over https on
# every build; overrides/all/hwdata takes them from seeds/hwdata instead (or
# keeps the tarball's), so neither lftp nor ca-certificates is needed and
# hwdata can come early (libdisplay-info below needs it).
# /usr/share/hwdata/pnp.ids does not exist") and looks for hwdata.pc.
# tree-sitter: "cargo fetch" downloads the crates over https on every
# build; the vendored tarball is not enough (wasmtime-c-api-impl in vendor/
# is a filtered stub, but the SlackBuild builds --all-features with wasm).
# sfs-seeds.sh fetches them on the host (seeds/cargo-home, used offline by
# overrides/all/tree-sitter); without it the build needs network + certs.
# p11-kit's configure looks for a CA bundle (/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
# ...) to set its trust paths and stops when there is none: "checking for
# trust module paths... configure: error: could not find".  ca-certificates
# makes the bundle when it is installed (doinst.sh: update-ca-certificates).
# Hidden until the Oct 15 snapshot: ngtcp2 now links gnutls, curl needs
# ngtcp2, so gnutls and p11-kit moved before ca-certificates.
# p11-kit's configure looks for a CA bundle (/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
# ...) to set its trust paths and stops when there is none: "checking for
# trust module paths... configure: error: could not find".  ca-certificates
# makes the bundle when it is installed (doinst.sh: update-ca-certificates).
# "python3 -m build" runs the build module, which imports these
# tools every SlackBuild expects (they are in stage 1, listed for completeness)
# .tar.zst sources are not in source/MANIFEST.bz2, so the scanner is blind there
# its Rust part runs bindgen at build time (fs/codegen.rs); the SlackBuild
# btrfs-progs configure: "cannot find sphinx-build, cannot build
# documentation" (docs are on by default, the SlackBuild never names sphinx)
# Documentation/conf.py loads the sphinx_rtd_theme extension (man pages too)
# dracut's Makefile builds the man pages with asciidoctor (a ruby gem)
# ocl-icd's Makefile generates its loader sources with ruby
# (icd_generator.rb, "make: ruby: No such file or directory"); the
# SlackBuild never names ruby, so no scanner sees it.
# before autoreconf; without it @CC_FOR_BUILD@ stays unexpanded
# glib2 builds its own GIRs (GLib/GObject/Gio-2.0.gir) only when
# gobject-introspection is installed, and g-i needs glib2: build glib2 once
# more right after g-i (harfbuzz: "Couldn't find include 'GObject-2.0.gir'")
# without it) and the package ships .pf2 fonts made from DejaVu and Hack when
# they are installed; both are plain font copies from x/

# xcomposite.pc requires xfixes; libXcomposite never links libXfixes
# x86 assembly: aom/dav1d/libvpx/ffmpeg configure stop without nasm (or
# yasm); libjpeg-turbo and libass quietly drop their SIMD code
# valadoc links graphviz (pass-1 override builds vala without valadoc)
# found while building (see DISCOVERED-DEPS.tsv for where each one shows up)
# data-only packages taken from the official tree (git clone at build time)

# numpy/arrayobject.h); numpy has no .so of its own for depgraph to see

# libplacebo -D glslang=enabled: glslang's static SPIRV library and shaderc
# come from x/vulkan-sdk (static libs: no ELF edge)
# mesa builds mesa-demos too (mesa-demos.build); its meson wants libdecor-0
# for the wayland demos and, when it is not installed, falls back to a
# libdecor/libdecor.git".  Offline that fails; with network it bundles
# libdecor's master branch.  Pat's mesa-demos-subprojects.tar.lz is empty
# (his system has libdecor), so build libdecor first, as on his machine.
# zxing-cpp -DZXING_UNIT_TESTS=ON: zxing.cmake takes GTest from the system
# and otherwise git clones googletest (FetchContent; offline it fails).  Pat
# vulkan-sdk's gfxreconstruct includes <xcb/xcb_keysyms.h>; it loads the
# library with dlopen (xcb_keysyms_loader), so no ELF edge shows it.

# not found in PYTHONPATH"; glad generates with jinja2 when it runs

# (frei0r-plugins -> opencv -> ffmpeg): pass-1 override builds without it

# ibus configure: PKG_CHECK_MODULES iso-codes (data + a .pc file, no ELF edge)

# recommended (d/dev86; the SlackBuild never names them)
# at's configure looks for sendmail (atd mails job output: "No mail command
# specified" without it); in this tree only n/postfix has /usr/sbin/sendmail

# ... and makes the .otb fonts with fonttosfnt (x/x11 app)
